title: MadeAlbum
description: MUSIC-STUDIO-ALBUM. An album the household made here: a title, the made band it belongs to, the sound every track reuses, a cover and the ordered tracks. A track is a normal made song (a media-item whose `made_artist_id` is the band), so the album only lists their ids in play order; there is no second copy of a song. It holds the SAME shared `style` and `seed` definitions as song-style and made-artist (one definition each), and may name a saved SongStyle it started from. Person scope, always labelled 'Made here'. Title and blurb are a person's own words and are never logged (rule 6a). The cover is a picture made from `cover_seed`: the same seed and look make the same cover, a new seed makes a new one.

title.description: The album's title. Trimmed; not unique.

origin.description: Always made: an album found in the library is a media-item album, not this record.

made_artist_id.description: The made band the album belongs to; null for an album of mixed artists.

song_style_id.description: The saved SongStyle the album started from, if any. `style` is the album's own copy and wins.

blurb.description: A short plain-text description for the album page. Never HTML. Passes the same output gate as chat before it is stored (rule 10).

look.description: The words the cover picture is made from (what it should look like).

cover_seed.description: The picture seed of the cover. Remaking the cover picks a new one.

track_media_ids.description: The tracks in play order, as media-item ids. Removing a track here does not delete the song.

source.description: hub: authoritative on the hub. local: made on a robot, not yet synced.

provenance.description: Free text naming who made the album, for example 'person-a1b2c3 (self)'.

deleted_at.description: Set when the album is deleted, so a syncing client drops it. Its tracks stay as songs.
